drm/i915: Split intel_cpu_transcoder_get_m_n() into M1/N1 vs. M2/N2 variants

As with intel_cpu_transcoder_set_m_n() let's split the readout
counterpart into explicit M1/N1 vs. M2/N2 variants as well.
